title: BatchOps
description: INPUT of `dmtool batch <ops.json>`, a JSON array of independent verb invocations run in one process. Dispatch is stateless and non-transactional: every op is attempted, a failed child never rolls back an earlier write, and each result echoes its `id`/`verb`/`args` plus exact exit. The outer envelope has `outcome:completed` and `data.dispatched:true` after full dispatch. `data.allExitedZero` reports whether every child exited zero in both modes. In ordinary mode, outer `ok` and the process exit follow `allExitedZero`. A NONZERO CHILD IS NOT NECESSARILY A FAILED CHILD, AND `ok` ALONE DOES NOT SEPARATE THEM: a verdict verb (`rule check`, `model check`, `workspace check`) exits 1 when its verdict is negative, and a comparison exits 1 when it differs, both while reporting `ok:true` because they ran; a kernel-gated candidate the kernel REFUSES (`computation add <spec> --dry-run`, `computation modify ... --dry-run`) exits 1 with `outcome:rejected` and `ok:false` — the operation did not succeed — while publishing the verdict that refused it, `valid:false` plus `verification:KERNEL_CONFIRMED`. Classify a child by what its own envelope ESTABLISHED (`valid` = the subject verdict, `data.matches` = the comparison), and read `ok` as whether that operation itself succeeded; never classify by exit alone. A child that failed to run carries no `valid` at all — a preflight rejection (`outcome:rejected`, no `valid`, no `verification`) and a non-envelope child are both failures. The aggregate `summary` reports the split as `<n> of <m> exited nonzero (<f> failed, <v> reported a negative verdict or comparison)`. Optional `--observations <file>` overwrites the compact deterministic static-kernel artifact described by this response's `observationArtifact` annotation; observation mode preflights every child and accepts only caller-tagged rule-check conditions or computation add/modify specs in --dry-run mode. In observation mode, full dispatch plus artifact write is the operation: outer `ok` is true and the process exits 0 even when `data.allExitedZero` is false, such as for an intentionally rejected negative control. A preflight refusal is `outcome:rejected`, exits 1, and writes nothing; a failed artifact write is `outcome:error` and exits 70. Per child, the artifact separates the axes: `valid:false` is a correctly rejected candidate whichever way `ok` reads (a rule-check verdict rejects with `ok:true`, a kernel-gated computation dry-run with `ok:false`), while a child that failed to run has `ok:false` and no `valid` at all. Use `apply` instead for ordered, atomic edits to one model ({target,op,...}, one terminal gate plus rollback; see `schema apply`).

verb.description: the verb to run (any except `batch`, which cannot nest)

args.description: the verb's argv (as on the command line, minus the verb)

id.description: optional caller tag, echoed back on the result for correlation; required and non-blank when --observations is used
